verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud's incident response docs state you can create on-call schedules, escalate alerts to whoever is on call, and coordinate incidents from declaration through post-incident review, with in-incident investigation using the triggering telemetry. Community comments independently confirm Grafana Cloud includes incident management and a separate OnCall service. missing for 10: explicit evidence of incident timelines, detailed documentation of escalation policy configuration beyond a one-line summary, clarity on availability outside Grafana Cloud.
